annotations.title: Photograph a website for a film

description: Opens a public web page in a sandboxed browser, records its text, pictures and layout, and returns a job whose result is a capture id. A capture is the raw material of ugcfans_make_launch_film and ugcfans_make_site_sting. Free of credits. Calling it confirms the person has the right to reuse the page's content in their own films. Only http and https pages on ports 80 and 443 can be captured.

url.description: The address of the page, starting with https:// or http://.

viewport.description: desktop captures a 1280 by 900 window (the default); phone captures 390 by 844 at twice the density.

name: ugcfans_capture_website
